input.summary: Audit of the Chiller at Surulere Chill Store reported 0 stock-outs, 100% compliance and all 10 planogram SKUs at expected facings — but confidence was only 0.34 with an explicit "low_conf" auditor note, so the photo cannot be trusted. Because nothing is reported as out or below minimum, no reorder is justified; and because the reading is unreliable, I did not treat the "all ok" result as confirmation either. No inventory lookup or purchase order was raised (no SKU met the reorder trigger), and no technician was dispatched (no telemetry and no visible equipment fault). A manager has been notified on WhatsApp to visually check the chiller and re-shoot the shelf photo so a trustworthy audit can be run.
